data: 133 new candidate groups, disjoint from all v5/v9/v10/v11/v13 reviewed groups and hashes; only source-train can enter new fitting. Old source-train shape-component labels reused.
algorithm: One extra compact shape probe per concept plus old positive and counter VQA logits; 12 GrabCut silhouette features. Balanced logistic L2=2, first three semantic coefficients constrained nonnegative; geometry free. No grid search.
topology: Gourd requires affirmative evidence for vertically stacked chambers, not adjacent vessels.
catalogue: Bowl-only explicit cup category veto using title/object_name head noun; no descriptions, no metadata positive override. Record image-only and metadata-assisted scores separately.
calibration: New dev only for meiping and bowl; gourd new dev has no confirmed positives, so include frozen old v11 gourd dev as explicitly reused calibration. Empirical precision>=.9 recall>=.5 TP>=2; if failed retain .5 and mark failed. Never tune on test.
evaluation: New test reported separately from old failure regression. Fresh gourd candidates may contain no positives; never claim recall when zero. AI visual+catalogue labels not independent human gold; metadata-assisted comparisons share catalogue evidence with labels.
deployment: No default replacement unless precision/recall and full-gallery audit support it. Color heads and grayscale policy unchanged.
